outcome.reason: Customer refused to pay and requested no further calls, using abusive language.

transcript.text:
Good morning! This is Mumbai Bank calling regarding your credit card account. We’ve noticed an overdue payment, and I’m here to assist you with clearing the outstanding amount. Delayed payments may affect your credit score and could even lead to legal action, so I’d recommend settling this soon.

Could you let me know when you’ll be able to make the payment? If you have any difficulties, I’m happy to help or discuss possible solutions.
Why do you people keep calling me about this? I've told you already, I can't pay right now. Stop harassing me.

I’m really sorry for any inconvenience caused—my intention isn’t to trouble you, but to help you find a solution. We do understand that sometimes it can be difficult to make payments. If you’re facing financial challenges, I can offer a reduction on your late fee or even work out a payment plan to ease the burden.

Please remember, continued non-payment will seriously affect your credit score and may lead to legal action. Would you like to discuss a discount or set up a manageable payment arrangement? I’m here to assist however I can.
What the hell is your problem? I said I can’t pay, so just fuck off already. Your "help" is just annoying as shit. Don’t call me again.

I understand your frustration, and I truly apologize for the inconvenience. My intention is only to help you avoid further complications, such as credit score impact or legal action. If you’d prefer, I can make a note to reduce the frequency of our calls or offer you the highest possible waiver of up to 50% on your late fees if that helps.

If it’s just a matter of timing, perhaps you could let me know when you might be able to pay, or if you’d like, I can call you back at a more convenient time.

Please let me know how you’d like to proceed—I’m here to assist, not to upset you.
I don’t give a shit about your damn waivers or notes. Just stop calling me you fucking moron. I’m sick of this bullshit. You’re wasting my time and mine. Fuck off!

I hear your frustration, and I apologize sincerely for upsetting you further. I’ll note your request regarding future calls. Please do remember, though, continued non-payment can seriously impact your credit score and may lead to legal action from the bank.

If you have a change of mind or need assistance in the future, we’re here to help. Thank you for your time today.
Yeah, whatever. Just stop calling me you assholes. I’m not paying, ever. So go fuck yourselves.
